sources.snippet: Overview LFM2-2.6B-Transcript is a 2.6-billion-parameter language model purpose-built for meeting transcription summarization, developed by LiquidAI. It runs entirely on-device across CPU, GPU, and NPU hardware, consuming under 3GB of RAM while handling 30-60 minute meeting transcripts.
